name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Everything that needs a person, from the attention list

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Offers expiring, visas not lodged, enquiries gone quiet, money to claim and chase.
sections.sql: select reason, who, owner, detail from attention order by priority, reason, who

sections.title: Offers waiting on the student
sections.sql: select ref, student, institution, stage, offer_expires_on, offer_expires_on - current_date as days_left from application_board where stage in ('conditional_offer','unconditional_offer') order by offer_expires_on

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: select t.title, t.due_on, coalesce(s.name, '-') as student, coalesce(st.name, '-') as owner from tasks t left join students s on s.id = t.student_id left join staff st on st.id = t.staff_id where t.done_on is null order by t.due_on

name: pipeline
title: Intakes and applications
subtitle: Who is going where, and what happens next

sections.title: By intake
sections.sql: select to_char(intake, 'YYYY-MM') as intake_month, institution, count(*) as students, string_agg(student || ' (' || replace(stage, '_', ' ') || ')', ', ' order by student) as who from application_board where intake >= current_date - 14 group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

sections.title: Every open application
sections.sql: select ref, student, institution, course, intake, replace(stage, '_', ' ') as stage, days_in_stage, counsellor, next_step from application_board where stage <> 'enrolled' order by intake

name: money
title: Commission
subtitle: What to claim, what to chase, and what is coming

sections.title: Claim now
sections.sql: select institution, currency, count(*) as claims, sum(amount_cents) as amount_cents, min(claimable_on) as oldest from commission_ledger where state = 'claim now' group by institution, currency order by amount_cents desc

sections.title: Invoiced and overdue
sections.sql: select institution, invoice_no, student, period, currency, amount_cents, days_since_invoice from commission_ledger where state = 'overdue' order by days_since_invoice desc

sections.title: Expected, next six months
sections.sql: select to_char(claimable_on, 'YYYY-MM') as month, currency, count(*) as claims, sum(amount_cents) as amount_cents, sum(amount_cents - sub_agent_share_cents) as ours_cents from commissions where status = 'expected' and claimable_on > current_date and claimable_on <= current_date + 183 group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

sections.title: How fast each institution pays
sections.sql: select i.name as institution, i.pays_within_days as terms, round(avg(cm.paid_on - cm.invoiced_on), 1) as avg_days, count(*) as paid from commissions cm join applications a on a.id = cm.application_id join courses c on c.id = a.course_id join institutions i on i.id = c.institution_id where cm.status = 'paid' and cm.invoiced_on >= current_date - 730 group by i.id order by avg_days desc
